newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 95 bln lire of Italy Cct.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 95 bln lire of Italy Cct.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 95 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 300 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 8.99 trillion lire at the open auction for the paper, against 3.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 101.45.
